text:
Aisha (Marketing): heads-up — planning the social rollout for next week's webinar 'Serving LLMs at Scale'. Need a quick hand: 3 LinkedIn posts (tease, webinar day, replay), one X thread (6 tweets), one 30s clip for short-form, and two hero images (16:9 + square). Also want clear UTMs so revops can route inbound. Can folks confirm capacity and timelines?

Tom K: sounds good. Primary CTA: sign up now or watch replay? Also what's the audience: devs vs enterprise?

Aisha (Marketing): primary CTA = sign up for live (we'll push replay after). Audience = devs + platform leads; tone should be technical but outcome-focused.

Jules (Design): I can do the two hero images + clip thumbnail. Need final copy and assets by EOD Thu to deliver on time. What dimensions for the 30s clip thumbnail?

Ravi (Content): I'll drop caption drafts here. Two headline variants (A/B) for LinkedIn and X. Also putting in short bullets for the X thread.

Ravi (Content): Variant A (technical): "How we serve LLMs with predictable latency and lower cost — join our webinar for an inside look at production optimizations."

Ravi (Content): Variant B (outcome): "Ship LLM features that scale — join our engineers to learn practical inference tricks that cut latency & cost."

Ravi (Content): X thread draft (6 tweets):
1) Running LLMs in prod is a different beast. We built a stack to make latency predictable and inexpensive. TL;DR: caching, routing, and quantization.
2) Caching: prefix & KV caching reduced repeated prefixes by 40% on average.
3) Routing: smart routing + fallbacks saved us from cascading capacity issues.
4) Quantization + kernel selection: 2x throughput on common workloads w/ minimal quality loss.
5) Want the metrics and war stories? Join our webinar Feb 3 — engineers will demo live.
6) RSVP: [link] — utm below.

Ravi (Content): UTM template: 
```
utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=serving-llms-webinar&utm_content={variant}
```
Replace {variant} with linkedin_a / linkedin_b / x_thread etc.

Maya (Revenue Ops): good call on UTMs. We'll route any UTM matching "serving-llms-webinar" into the webinar nurture list and assign MQL tag if they attend. Can you also add a hidden field in the signup form to capture original_channel? Otherwise attribution will be messy.

Aisha (Marketing): noted. Ravi — can you add a hidden original_channel param? Example: original_channel=x_linkedin_a

Ravi (Content): yep will add. Also attaching two caption length variants for the 30s clip (short + long).

Jules (Design): thumbnails: 1280x720 for clip, 1200x1200 for square. I'll start comps tonight. Any brand/regulatory copy we must include?

Aisha (Marketing): include standard footer: "Redwood Inference — production-ready LLM serving" + privacy CTA. No legal review required for this one.

Leo (Growth): Suggest we A/B the LinkedIn headline (A vs B) and run a small paid boost on the winning post post-webinar. Budget ask: $1k top-line. Also pin the X thread for 24hrs after live.

Maya (Revenue Ops): routing checklist:
- UTMs in place
- original_channel param captured
- landing page sends lead webhook to SFDC queue 'Webinar (Serv.)'
- assign owner for MQL follow-up (TBD)
I can implement webhooks if you confirm final form fields by Thu EOD.

Tom K: scheduling windows? Best times for dev audience are Tue-Thu 11am-1pm PT or Wed 2-4pm PT for APAC overlap. Webinar is Tue 10am PT — that should be fine for promotional posts.

SocialBot: Reminder created: "Social schedule: Serving LLMs webinar" on Feb 3 09:00 PT — includes tasks: publish teaser post, schedule X thread, schedule clip. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/serving-llms-webinar

Aisha (Marketing): action items:
- Ravi: finalize captions + add original_channel param (due Thu EOD)
- Jules: 2 hero images + clip thumbnail (first comps Wed evening, final Thu EOD)
- Maya: setup webhook & SFDC queue routing (confirm fields Thu)
- Tom: schedule posts in Scheduler, hold paid boost decision until post-webinar (Leo)
- SocialBot: schedule teaser (Mon), day-of posts (Tue 09:15 PT), replay push (Wed)

Aisha (Marketing): will follow up with a short doc with post timing & exact copy variants. @Jules @Ravi please drop final assets into #marketing-assets by Thu. Thanks everyone! :rocket:

Leo (Growth): one more — plan two engagement follow-ups the week after: 1) short blog highlight, 2) customer quote + case CTA. I'll draft copy after replay available. :+1:
